# Ontonomic

> Ontonomic is a UK-based research and engineering consultancy specialising in ontology engineering for large collections of political and legal text. Partners: Roy Gardner (Senior Partner), Sally Gardner and Callum Wilson. Associate: Matt Martin. Contact: enquiries@ontonomic.com

Ontonomic treats ontologies as engineered artefacts: designed carefully, tested against evidence, maintained over time, and compared on their merits. Designing an ontology and applying it to real documents are treated as inseparable tasks.

## Services

- [Ontology engineering](https://ontonomic.com/#ontology-engineering): build ontologies, code text, analyse topic networks. LLM-based coding of text segments against an ontology, with calibration, and analysis of topic networks traceable to the supporting text.
- [Knowledge graphs](https://ontonomic.com/#knowledge-graphs): entity and relation extraction from text, built on domain ontologies. We combine graphs with tensors to support structured querying and analysis over source text.
- [Data infrastructure](https://ontonomic.com/#data-infrastructure): design and engineering of research data platforms, including the CCP Portal for the Comparative Constitutions Project.

## Research

- Sentence-level semantic similarity for text and concept analysis.
- Ontology expansion and comparison, including the SAT method for topic integration.
- Tensor-based analysis of topic co-occurrence across documents.
- Corpora: peace agreements and peace process documents, national security documents, national constitutions, constitutional court decisions, research ethics documentation.
- Programmes: PeaceRep (University of Edinburgh), Comparative Constitutions Project, Concept Integration Lab, Linnaeus, Mapping Security Threats in National Security Documents.

## Applications

- RIDA: an AI retrievability audit tool measuring how visible an academic journal is to AI retrieval and RAG pipelines.
- Graphtensor: a natural language query system for structured research corpora, compiling questions into operations across a knowledge graph and a tensor space.
